title: The Bakery of Sandpiper Point
author: Mara Oyelaran
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
